title: Bonn intracranial EEG segments, sets C, D and E (Andrzejak et al. 2001)
description: This dataset repackages the intracranial EEG segments (sets C, D and E) of the Bonn epilepsy dataset into BIDS format. It contains 300 single-channel segments of 23.6 s each, drawn from five epilepsy patients undergoing presurgical evaluation. The segments cover seizure-free intervals recorded in the hippocampal formation and in the epileptogenic zone, as well as ictal activity. The data were originally collected to study nonlinear deterministic and finite-dimensional structure in brain electrical activity. All samples are identical to the published source files.
methods_description: Intracranial EEG was recorded with depth electrodes in the hippocampal formations and strip electrodes on the lateral and basal neocortex. All signals were acquired on the same 128-channel amplifier system using an average common reference. Recordings were digitized with 12-bit A/D conversion at 173.61 Hz and band-pass filtered at 0.53-40 Hz. Segments of 23.6 s were selected after visual artifact inspection and a weak-stationarity criterion. The conversion to BrainVision format involved no filtering, resampling, re-referencing or rescaling.
